integrity: Standalone exact finite-field verification accompanies a general mathematical proof. Computer enumeration is not an infinite proof. Same-model scientific review passed; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Specified F3 model only; nontrivial twists and other del Pezzo surfaces are outside scope. Geometric F9 fullness and the 28-hyperflex configuration are prior results. New priority is limited to F3 arithmetic descent, odd-degree boundary stabilization and complete compact-support Frobenius eigenvalues; historical novelty remains provisional.
title: Arithmetic boundary and compactly supported cohomology of the ternary Fermat degree-two del Pezzo surface
